title: 2021-01-28 Onboarding retro with Kombinera
content:
Date: 28th January 2021

Attendees: & from Kombinera. from the DevOps team.

Kombinera resources:

Github: https://github.com/inter-ikea/cbf-re-ipex-kombinera

Azure DevOps: https://dev.azure.com/iissab-ipex/Kombinera

What was discussed

  • Azure Pipelines

  • Azure Function and Basic Auth

  • Github Actions

  • Terraform

  • Contributing to IPEX Default-CICD

Azure Pipelines

Kombinera is today using Azure Pipelines for their build logic. They are building, testing and deploying their solution from Pipelines as well as managing their infrastructure there.

Azure Function and Basic Auth

The team is currently using an Azure Function to proxy calls to the deployed environments with Basic Auth.

Github Actions

Due to currently lacking functionality in Azure DevOps, the team uses a custom Github action to allow their workflow to function fully. https://github.com/inter-ikea/cbf-re-ipex-kombinera/blob/develop/.github/workflows/pr-lifecycle.yml

Terraform

Kombinera is using Terraform to manage their Infrastructure as Code.

Contributing to IPEX Default-CICD

Kombinera will contribute Pull-requests to https://github.com/inter-ikea/cbf-re-ipex-devops-default-cicd repository.
